name: @feasibleone/blong-log
description: Real-time log viewer for the Blong framework

scripts.ci-test: rc=0; blong-dev test || rc=$?; node --run storybook:test:ci || rc=$?; exit $rc
scripts.storybook:test:ci: blong-dev browsers || exit 1; mkdir -p .ci-report; SBLOG=.ci-report/storybook.log; SBDEV=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/blong-log-storybook-$$.log; storybook dev --ci --quiet --loglevel warn --port 6006 >"$SBDEV" 2>&1 & SERVER=$!; for i in $(seq 1 120); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:6006 && break; sleep 1; done; FORCE_COLOR=0 NO_COLOR=1 npx test-storybook --url http://127.0.0.1:6006 --json --outputFile .ci-report/storybook.json >"$SBLOG" 2>&1; EXIT=$?; kill $SERVER 2>/dev/null; blong-dev report jest --input .ci-report/storybook.json --runner storybook --status $EXIT || true; if [ $EXIT -ne 0 ]; then echo '--- storybook test log ---'; cat "$SBLOG"; echo '--- storybook dev log ---'; cat "$SBDEV"; else SBSUM=$(grep -E '^(Test Suites|Tests|Snapshots):' "$SBLOG" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';' | sed 's/;$//;s/;/; /g'); [ -z "$SBSUM" ] && SBSUM='(the log carries no summary line)'; echo "# storybook: $SBSUM"; echo "# storybook log: $SBLOG"; fi; rm -f "$SBDEV"; exit $EXIT
